_about: Public-domain Samuel Miller (1769-1850, second professor at Princeton Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: Letters on Clerical Manners and Habits (New York: Carvill, 1827), An Essay on the Warrant, Nature and Duties of the Office of the Ruling Elder (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, catalogued 1832), Infant Baptism Scriptural and Reasonable (1835), A Continuation of Letters concerning the Constitution and Order of the Christian Ministry (1809) and A Brief Retrospect of the Eighteenth Century (New York, 1803, 2 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR.
